title: slice run closes folded tasks in its close commit
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run --close <id>` (repeatable) closes folded tasks in the same close commit as the slice task, so a folded task needs no amend and no second verify.
Evidence: PR #207 folded t-625v6fr; the lead closed it after the runner close commit, amended that commit and reran krn verify by hand.
Proof: an observer that runs a slice with --close t-x and asserts one close commit changes both task records.
